[h1]The Absinthia Kickstarter[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/26ebbd896333ab8579ca8346b593b8039aa40538.png[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/absinthia][b]The [i]Absinthia [/i]Kickstarter is LIVE! Here's the link![/b][/url]

And here's a quick overview of the reward tiers:

[b]Tier 1:[/b] Digital Key
[b]Tier 2:[/b] OST + Desktop Wallpapers
[b]Tier 3:[/b] Digital copies of [i]Celestial Hearts[/i] and [i]Knight Bewitched[/i]
[b]Tier 4:[/b] Absinthia Early Access (~1-2 months in advance)

The following tiers also include tiers 1-4 and a unique [url=discord.gg/cE2fCQAjC6]Discord[/url] server role:

[b]Will there be digital keys offered for other platforms (namely the Nintendo Switch)?[/b]

Nope, not this time! For context, the physical rewards offered with the Knight Bewitched campaign were a total wash (I actually [i]lost[/i] money from them, and they were a [i]huge [/i]time sink!)

[b]Is [i]Absinthia [/i]a sequel?[/b]

[i]Absinthia[/i] takes place some time after the events and features some characters from my previous game [i]Celestial Hearts[/i]. That said, [i]Absinthia[/i]'s story was written to stand alone, so you don't need to play [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] or [i]Celestial Hearts[/i] first to enjoy the story.

[b]Is this game SFW?[/b]

Yes. The story features sapphic/yuri elements, but there is no nudity/NSFW content.

If you have any further questions, feel free to comment here or on the Kickstarter page itself! Once again, [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/absinthia]here is a link to the Kickstarter[/url][/b]. See you there, and have a great week!

Hello everyone!

I have a few announcements to make! First, I released a small patch last month as well as one just now:

Second, [url=https://share.amuse.io/album/pnk-shba-knight-bewitched-original-game-soundtrack][b]The Enhanced Edition soundtrack is now available on Spotify![/b][/url] This contains all 15 tracks composed by Jazz Stewart as well as a few previously-unused tracks! Give it a listen!

[h2]Team Bewitched and Absinthe[/h2]

The unofficial-official [b]Team Bewitched[/b] is now a thing, consisting of myself, my composer [url=https://jazzstewart.carrd.co/]Jazz Stewart[/url], and my co-writer and consultant [url=https://twitter.com/CelahGinal]Ginal[/url].

We are currently developing [b]Absinthe[/b], a new story that takes place shortly after the events of [i]Celestial Hearts[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/dcc7243ab9b195a88dc88eb348588869a1d433ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/b389060e68d912504485c4914860d1dcdb2400d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/66557a705b3c1e4ae23e2678cfccdf8fcd726d02.png[/img]
(WIP)

The Ambrose Isles are home to many villages and towns. One such village is Katti Town, a homely, peaceful village where everyone knows everyone. 

One day, Katti Town was suddenly besieged by a horde of shadowy minions and their leader, a woman named Lilith. But before they could even begin to lay waste, another unknown knight came to the rescue and repelled Lilith's army with ease. 

The knight introduced herself as Freya and quickly became known as the hero of Katti Town. She took three villagers under her wing: Sera, a budding warrior who fights to protect her grandmother, Thomas, an aspiring mage, and his partner Jake, a talented, if not uninspired, rogue. Together, they began preparing Katti Town to face Lilith's next assault.

Sera, Jake and Thomas are optimistic, but soon they will learn Lilith's true intentions and why Freya is there to begin with--[i]the hard way[/i].

---

If you'd like to stay updated on Absinthe's progress, feel free to [url=https://twitter.com/Jkweath]follow me on Twitter[/url]. If all goes well, we hope to have a demo ready by January and a Kickstarter campaign by early 2022.

Have a great weekend and stay safe!

notes.title: The Enhanced Edition will launch on August 2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/a5da0f03a490f320c1433c1e19427bb9a78255db.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

The [i]Enhanced Edition[/i] will launch on[b] August 2[/b] (just a little over two weeks!). 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/815150/view/3048344718966551422]You can view this previous announcement for all the changes coming to Knight Bewitched.[/url] It's a bit outdated, but still accurate!

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

[b]How much will the Enhanced Edition cost?[/b]

The Enhanced Edition is [b]completely free[/b] for anyone who already owns [i]Knight Bewitched[/i]. The price of the game itself will remain at $4.99. If you'd like to support the Enhanced Edition after its launch, you can check out the Player's Guide and Soundtrack DLC!

[b]Will all the old content be returning?[/b]

Yes. Every optional boss, as well as everything added in content updates, such as The Depths, will remain in the Enhanced Edition.

[b]Will the old version still be available?[/b]

Yes. When you launch Knight Bewitched from Steam, you'll be presented the option to either launch the Enhanced Edition or the "Legacy Edition" - this way, you're free to compare and contrast the two versions as you see fit.

Note that, due to an engine upgrade and the massive number of changes, save files *will not* transfer between the two versions.

[b]Will the Enhanced Edition recieve new achievements?[/b]

Yes. There will be at least 6 new achievements, with most of them being tied to the new content.

[b]How much will the player guide and soundtrack cost as DLC?[/b]

Current plan is to price the guide and soundtrack at $2.99 each. This might change depending on how large the guide and soundtrack end up being.

Note that the soundtrack DLC will *only* include the new music tracks composed by Jazz Stewart as I don't have the rights to distribute any of the other tracks.

[b]Do I need to play the entire Knights of Ambrose saga to understand it?[/b]

Not anymore. I explained this in an update from long ago, but long story short: The Knights of Ambrose Saga has 2 timelines:

Timeline A: Knight Bewitched -> Mari and the Black Tower -> Knight of Heaven (Finding Light) -> Knight Eternal

Timeline B: Knight Bewitched -> Knight Bewitched 2 -> Celestial Hearts

That's all I have for today! Until next time!

notes.title: Announcing Knight Bewitched: Enhanced Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/481d53376becc960e2186c2e63ec62e1136a1155.png[/img]
(A new logo is coming soon, too!)

Hello everyone!

I've mentioned it a few times, but this is the official announcement for the [i]Knight Bewitched Enhanced Edition.[/i]

A *lot* of stuff is coming...

[h1]Here is an incomplete list of changes: [/h1]
[i][b](this list is subject to change)[/b][/i]

[h3]Engine and game info[/h3]
[list]
[*][i]Knight Bewitched: Enhanced Edition[/i] is being ported to the recently released [i]MZ[/i] engine. This upgrade is mainly focused on back-end improvements, but it also comes with a new battle animation system and enables many of the UI upgrades and new features
[*]Lighting effects have been removed and replaced with fog/other effects where applicable. You'll still need the Blue Flame to enter the Midnight Desert, though!
[*]8-directional movement was added
[*]Auto-saving was added
[*]*Mac and Linux support
[*]*Auto-battle was added. You can toggle it during battle or have it on automatically through the options menu.
[*]Due to the engine upgrade and the massive changelog, [b]old save files will not be compatible with the enhanced edition[/b]
[*]The Enhanced Edition is[b] [u]completely free[/u][/b] for anyone who already owns [i]Knight Bewitched[/i]. The price will remain at $4.99. If crowdfunding succeeds, a comprehensive player's guide and soundtrack will be available as paid DLC
[*]ETA is mid-late fall 2021
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/22264fc700f6885ff1cdb9a652ed5e5369656ca9.gif[/img]

[h3]UI and menus[/h3]
[list]
[*]Almost every menu in the game has a new and improved layout
[*]Default window resolution was reduced to 1109x624 as the original 1280x720 resolution just caused a lot of empty space
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/b825eaa714734762e79d6c56c9696109ab63c4c5.png[/img]

[h3]Story and Dialogue[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dialogue and cutscenes have received major writing revisions
[*]Many scenes, such as the Northshire Inn scene, Ruth's first meeting with Gwen, and the throne room scenes have been altered significantly (as in, more than just dialogue touch-ups)
[*]Character backstories and motivations have been improved as a result
[*]Aside from all this, the main storyline will remain mostly the same...[i]mostly[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Locations[/h3]
[list]
[*]Every area in the game is being rebuilt from scratch. Some areas will only receive cosmetic changes, while others will be changed or expanded significantly. Here are a few examples:
[list]
[*]The entrance to Typhus the Younger's Lair has been expanded slightly, and fog effects/cave ambience were added. Typhus' Lair can also be revisited later in the game as part of a new sidequest
[*]The Underbog has a new section. The swamp areas can no longer be traversed, but a new mechanic was added with switches that can raise/lower the swamp level
[*]Halonia has many cosmetic improvements. Ruth's House is now in its own separate new section of Halonia. A new building was added in Halonia's middle section for Kickstarter backers
[*]Gabenport was completely revised
[*]The Midnight Desert, Morgoth's Cave, The Sealed Tower and Typhus' Castle will also be revised significantly
[/list]
[*]The World Map is larger and significantly improved from the original. Many small areas, such as Arcanite Ore locations and the secret merchant, were relocated
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/19c20b6bb8fa9040c77a81f2f8e90b217b1ae400.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/22b6d42b6f1de2d118dbf226decd8d1d02d42476.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/62d942ddfdb80bf2b88218847b4ac2505a3186ed.png[/img]

[h3]Stats, skills, equipment and Battle Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*]Stat spreads for hero classes and equipment were ported over from [i]Knight Bewitched 2.[/i] In brief: Numbers are bigger, equipment upgrades feel better, and everything hits harder
[*]Helmets are out. Chest armor gives higher stat bonuses in their place
[*]Slash, Blunt, and Pierce weapon "elements" were removed
[*]Weapons and armors give smoother and more predictable stat bonuses
[*]About 1/3 of all hero skills were cut. Most of the skills removed were "fluff" i.e. they were useless/rarely used/had the same effect as a different skill/etc. Some new skills were added to each character, and many skills that remain were either made more powerful or given new effects
[*]MP costs were adjusted, mostly higher--but many new spells and items grant MP recovery/MP regeneration
[*]Trinkets only grant 1 skill each. Except for Uno, each character can now equip 2 trinkets
[*]A new "Charm" equipment slot was added. Enemies now drop Essences that are used to craft charms
[*]Enemy mechanics, such as Counter-Attacks, Empowered buffs, and new Fog and Enrage effects were added
[*]There are now 12 Arcanite Ores to find. Each character has an associated legendary weapon that they can reforge at Ullo's Forge with 3 Arcanite Ores.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/3b8d7885887eb0c03fc343479558474526e99202.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/cee53bc14a780b82288fe2b5fad936846dfd4489.png[/img]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*]An in-game encyclopedia tracks all items, weapons, armors and enemies encountered
[*]A charm-crafting system was added and unlocks after Gwen joins the party:
[list]
[*]Enemies drop unique essences that are used alongside other items to craft powerful charms
[*]The player can combo together certain charms, equipment and skills to devastating effect in battle
[*]Some unique potions can also be crafted
[*]More potions and charms are unlocked as the story progresses
[/list]
[*][i]Alpha Beasts[/i] make their return from [i]Knight Bewitched 2[/i]. Alpha Beasts are rare, much stronger creature variants that'll drop extra cool stuff--if you can defeat them!
[*][i]Secret Areas[/i]: Similar to the secret areas in [i]Celestial Hearts,[/i] almost every town and dungeon will have a hidden area that contains gold and powerful items. Keep an eye out!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/4a22419d612fb18261bbfb931ceab288c4608bb1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/12342b0eb018995e922f5fef865a7c0fabe95ea9.png[/img]

[h3]New content (subject to change)[/h3]
[list]
[*] [i]The quest for Daedalus[/i] - Stray's desecrated hometown of Nilheim, where the player can engage on a sidequest to retrieve Stray's family heirloom stolen by the Cult of Drakon
[*] [i]Shipwrecked![/i] - a naval confrontation with a certain Archmage will result in the party stranded on an island where they'll face new enemies and learn more about Uno's past. This'll also lead into an updated cutscene (hopefully with an art illustration) back at the Witch House
[*] [i]Redemption[/i] - The very same Archmage mentioned above will have a slightly different character arc toward the later part of the story. Without going into spoilers, endgame events will unfold somewhat differently
[/list]

[h3]Kickstarter Goals[/h3]
[list]
[*]A Kickstarter will be launched in late March-early April to fund the following upgrades:
[list]
[*] In-game art illustrations added to the most impactful cutscenes
[*] A mostly-new soundtrack composed by [url=https://twitter.com/JazzStewart3]Jazz Stewart[/url]
[*] A comprehensive player's guide featuring illustrations, complete map layouts and locations, appendices, etc
[*]The new soundtrack and guide will be free for certain Kickstarter tier backers and available as paid DLC for everyone else
[/list]
[*] A demo of the [i]Enhanced Edition[/i] will be available during the Kickstarter.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=e2fKyKQNQC4;full][/previewyoutube]

Out of all the new stuff, I'm personally most excited about the story and dialogue revisions. When I first started on the update, I was surprised to see just how...rough...the writing was in [i]Knight Bewitched[/i]. While the story will still play out the same way, I can't overstate just how much better the dialogue is this time around. I've had a fun time re-writing the characters, and I hope you'll enjoy it too!

I've already made significant progress on the Enhanced Edition, so I'll be setting up the crowdfunding campaign soon and aiming to launch sometime early-mid April. Unlike the [i]Celestial Hearts[/i] campaign, I plan on having a physical reward or two this time too!

[h3]Suggestions[/h3]

If you have any feedback or suggestions for things you'd like to see in the Enhanced Edition, you're free to leave a comment here or email me directly at Jkweath@gmail.com.

If you'd like to see frequent updates on the Enhanced Edition, and just more stuff about me in general, [url=https://twitter.com/Jkweath]you can also follow me on Twitter.[/url]

Until next time!

notes.title: Celestial Hearts is 100% funded! Now let's talk stretch goals...
notes.content:
Hello again![url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/celestial-hearts][b] As of today, we've hit 100% of the campaign goal for Celestial Hearts[/b][/url]! I never imagined we'd hit it this fast. I greatly appreciate everyone who's helped us come this far!
For this update, I want to talk about the three stretch goals I lined out on the main Kickstarter page, and also to clarify a couple other details on the "Become a Statue" backer tiers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/4980f4b9731fbe4b3a1b214b5292265645a72074.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/4f09fbf508e34fdbd646226a535249f37271e72a.png[/img]

Those who back at the $20 tier and up will have a statue for themselves placed in this room. The character on the statue will be randomly generated (though I can take small requests for how the character should look). Backers will be asked the following questions:

-What name to leave on the statue (if I don't receive a reply, I'll go with your Kickstarter name. Full names will have their last name abbreviated)
-Whether you'd like to show your contribution ('no' by default)
-A short message you'd like to leave

If requested, I can also place a small weapon in front of the statue - I mostly have sword variations, but I also have an axe, daggers, scepter and bow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/0867dce10820344c8fd49258165e8b2bd5e693f4.png[/img]

[h2]$1300 Stretch goal: Vagrant's Arena[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/fec040665e00ea877ad4f64740199bfac7e67608.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/23ed8c7ba9a87016e2a7c0486731cd89b8f5ed81.png[/img]

Vagrant's Arena is a place for adventurers from all around the world to come and prove their worth in combat. After facing four waves of enemies without rest--and no items--you'll then face off against another group of adventurers much like yourselves!

Vagrant himself is the grandson of a certain young dragon knight you might be familiar with--and if you're lucky, he won't be the only descendant-of-a-famous-hero you run into here.

[h2]$1500 Stretch goal: The Depths[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/b955279fdd187eae76561a31af8b481560ee133a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/5e1c8c5e1466314797c251113353aaf50bb8a7d7.png[/img]

Featured in two of my previous titles, [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] and [i]Finding Light[/i], The Depths is a massive challenge dungeon comprised of four smaller dungeons and a, erm... Rather odd town stuck in the middle.

While the layout of The Depths is the same as in the previous titles, the environments are all slightly different--as well as the loot, enemies and bosses. Both The Depths and Vagrant's Arena will have elements that tie into the main story as well.

[b]$2000 Stretch goal: New hero battle sprites[/b]

So I gotta be honest here: I hadn't planned on hitting the crowdfunding goal this soon. I figured it'd be a last-minute thing where some generous donor would cover the last bit of funding needed just hours before the campaign ended - let alone hitting the goal over a week beforehand!

The $2000 stretch goal outlined in the Kickstarter is aimed toward replacing the "stock" hero sprites during battle scenes with new, higher-quality sprites. Unfortunately, I don't have an example image to show what a new set of sprites would look like. I'll be on the lookout for an artist who can do this work--and if the campaign looks like it might hit the $2000 stretch goal before the 26th, I'll release another update promoting it and going for one big final push!

Thanks again to all of you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask (I've probably missed something!). We still have 9 days to go!

Have a great week and stay safe!

notes.title: Kickstarter and Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're not far into the campaign and we've already passed the 50% mark! That's great news, and I'm really happy that people are as excited for Celestial Hearts as I am. There's 16 days left, and we still have a long way to go!

All 25 of the $7 Early Backer Rewards have been taken, but (at the time of this update) there are still some Early Backer Pre-Release rewards left. For just $3 more, you can have Celestial Hearts two weeks in advance!

Anyway, I wanted to share that I've added a new $50 backer tier:

[h3]Design a weapon![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/5c7a0dafc1d223852fa0615205d3d62f5efc93b7.gif[/img]

Unlike my previous releases (like Knight Bewitched), Celestial Hearts uses a side-view battle system. Thanks to that, you can actually see the weapons each party member is equipped with--and if you're interested, you can design your own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/109815a3a9838e2ca9d3fe4b82de36c30c2ddfb6.png[/img]

Of course, if you're not an artist, you can simply describe how you want the weapon to look, and I can either pull from a selection of weapons on-hand or commission an artist myself.

Here's the details for this new backer tier:

[list]
[*] The size of the weapon can be up to 48 x 48 pixels. (you could make the weapon smaller, but then you wouldn't be able to see it!)
[*]You can provide a name (up to 20 characters) and, optionally, a short description around 20 words / 120 characters.
[*]I will determine the stats of the weapon, but you can specify what stats or elemental affinities you'd rather the weapon be geared toward (is this a "hit-things-first, ask-questions-later kind of weapon? Maybe it's more defensive? Or a lightning-fast dagger, perhaps?)
[/list]

Here are the weapon types you can choose from, and which character they'll belong to:
[list]
[*]Kayah: hunting horns / horn-like weapons
[*]Helen: swords, maces / hammers, spears
[*]Sylvie: bows, crossbows
[*]Gail: knives, ringblades / fist weapons, scythes / khopesh
[*]Matthias: staves / staff-like weapons
[/list]

This $50 backer tier has 6 spots available and includes all other rewards below it. If you've already backed the project, you're free to upgrade to this tier anytime.

Long story short - it's coming along smoothly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/5b6e6a6ed796816fb394f5c53ce90777e723b2e9.png[/img]

I don't have a whole lot to show off right now, but the project has reached its second-to-final stage of development: Writing! Just about everything else is finished, and all that's left to do is actually write the dialogue, design the cutscenes, and then begin the long process of playtesting!

Based on my current rate of progress, I'm thinking Celestial Hearts will be finished by late December and will release in late January/early February. This means that those subscribed to the Early Backer pre-release tier will receive their Steam copies around mid-January.

That's all for now! If you have any questions or comments about Celestial Hearts, the new backer tier (or any other tier), or just want to say something, you can leave a comment here or email me at Jkweath@gmail.com.

notes.title: Knight Bewitched 2 - Current progress, Twitter updates
notes.content:
Heya!

Though Knight Bewitched 2 is still very early in development, I'd like to talk about progress made with it so far as well as a couple new features.

Much of the work done with Knight Bewitched 2 so far has involved improving the game's base scenes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/04660cfd4e31b9ef8410d7ce6b117386c34f2bcf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/ad3df883eb7646da707cff49719d783a9e269142.png[/img]

[b][url=https://twitter.com/Jkweath/status/1224070899340541953]I've uploaded a video showcasing some of the new menus on my Twitter feed.[/url][/b] I don't post on Twitter often, but I highly recommend you follow me If you'd like to stay up-to-date on Knight Bewitched 2.

[h3]An eight-person party[/h3]

All four original members of [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] are returning, alongside three new characters and one more you'll be very familiar with. You'll start off being introduced to the three new players, with the party slowly being built up as the story progresses. Expect to see many side-stories and cutscenes exploring the relationships between all eight characters!

[h3]Enemy Barriers[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/6f8a07eee0772be499d5f5eeea1771e2bac1527d.png[/img]

A new battle mechanic, both enemies and allies alike can gain HP Barriers with certain skills and equipment. Barriers will need to be depleted before damage can be dealt. Some skills will deal increased damage to barriers, and some skills will bypass barriers entirely!

[h3]Skill Enhancers[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/b078efc300823c96041af8217fb976ece63b1d6c.png[/img]

Replacing the Trinket system, allies can now equip Skill Enhancers, upgrading an older skill to a newer, more powerful skill with added effects. 50 skill enhancers will be available, and much like Trinkets, will be hidden all across the Ambrose Underground for the player to find.

Speaking of the Ambrose Underground...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32517448/bb207330f6a5083f94167369380d627de8439ccf.png[/img]

The majority of the game's story will take place here. Fans of [i]Finding Light[/i] will recognize a few of the locations here. No spoilers yet!

[h3]Release date, What's Coming Next[/h3]

Though the game is still early in development, I've already began commissioning the game's artwork. One thing [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] sorely lacked on its release was artwork. For the sequel, I'd like to include some artwork shown in scenes in-game. In the upcoming months, I may host a Kickstarter to help secure funds for this, but some extra artwork is guaranteed to show up even if the Kickstarter falls through.

[i]Knight Bewitched 2[/i] will have an expansive world with more content than my previous games, so right now I'm putting the release window sometime between August and September.

Unlike with all of my previous games, I plan on announcing updates as the game progresses on Twitter - [url=https://twitter.com/Jkweath]so if you're interested in seeing progress on Knight Bewitched 2, follow me![/url]

notes.title: Project pipeline, Astraea, The Black Dungeon, and JKGames
notes.content:
Hello! It's not often I do announcements like this (never, even!) but I know that my games have a small following who I'm sure would be interested in seeing what I've been up to:

[b]Knight Bewitched[/b]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jkgames.knightbewitched]Knight Bewitched is available on the Google Play Store for $1.99.[/url].

In the past two months since its release I've fixed plenty of bugs and updated the UI to be more responsive and less intrusive during battle scenes.

[b]Knight of Heaven: Finding Light[/b]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.jkgames.findinglight]Finding Light is also now available on the Google Play Store for $1.99![/url] It will be on sale for just $0.99 until July 18.

The prefix "Knight of Heaven" was added mostly to help it appear in search results, since searching "Finding Light" on the Play Store yields a bunch of flashlight apps.

In its mobile transition, Finding Light was updated to have a wide-screen resolution. It is slightly easier (though about the same difficulty in Hard mode) and has a few numbers tweaks on equipment and stat growths, but besides that is identical to its PC counterpart.

One last thing on Finding Light - [url=https://joshua-keith.itch.io/finding-light]it is also available on Itch.io for $3.99[/url] ($6 cheaper than Steam!)

[b]The Black Dungeon RPG (formerly Mari and the Black Tower)[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517448/c219b656b532e55fc88bbd1318f1bfde25721491.png[/img]

Mari and the Black Tower was my first game; it was originally built to be an Android release, but was eventually transitioned to Steam before falling into obscurity.

Early this week Mari and the Black Tower will be re-released on the Google Play Store for $1.99 under the name [i]The Black Dungeon RPG[/i] along with a few big changes:

[list]
[*][i]Massive[/i] dialogue overhaul - almost every line of text in the entire story was revised and is now up to my current writing standards
[*]Torches were removed from the game, "dark rooms" are gone, and Lighting Effects are turned off by default*
[*]Updated window graphics and font
[*]The Marauder and Horn Artist have new passive abilities more suited to their roles
[*]Compared to its previous release, will have significantly improved controls (the same as the other two games in the series) and some performance improvements
[*]Overhauled quest log to make it easier to change in case the game receives any content updates (in general, the game was set up for content updates if demand calls for it)
[*]Select memes are now slightly more relevant
[/list]

*The change to lighting effects was necessary to lower the game's system requirements for mobile devices. Lighting effects can still be turned on in the options if you're using a high-end mobile device.

Besides these changes, the story and game play remain almost completely unchanged.

I currently don't have plans to update the Steam version of Mari and the Black Tower, though I can if there is somehow demand for it.

The release of The Black Dungeon RPG will complete my jRPG suite for Android. Each game is $1.99 and will very often go on sale for $0.99, so if you're a fan be sure to pick them up! 

--Provided, that is, you're using a good mobile device that can handle them, as though the games were relatively easy to port to Android, the engine they run on isn't well-suited to the processing power most mobile devices provide.

[b][url=jkgames.net]Jkgames.net[/url][/b]

[url=jkgames.net]I now have a website![/url] The purpose is mostly to list my games (as well as any upcoming games) and to write about indie game development when I feel like it. There's not a whole lot there yet, but it's sure to be updated plenty in the coming months

[b]What's next[/b]

Normally I don't talk about upcoming projects. I have a good reason for this - in the past six months I've started on four separate projects and cancelled them for one reason for another. 

From a story about an enslaved mistress and a demonic concubine featuring the Knight Bewitched graphics set, to a modern-day setting starring four kids including a certain young girl named Abigail, to a first-person-labyrinth-explorer DnD-style game that was nothing like anything I'd done before, none of these games made it past the first 25% of development, so if I'd announced them previously it would've been a bad time.

That being said, I think I've made enough progress on the next (and possibly last) game in the Ambrose series, [i]Astraea[/i] that I can officially announce it:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517448/116afec88b7494ef9dab7252947b9b584f445711.png[/img]

[i]Astraea[/i] will use the same graphics and sound set as Finding Light (though in full color), and will take place ~10 years after. [i]Astraea[/i] will feature a skill tree system (pictured above) an updated crafting system, new and returning characters ([i]Finding Light[/i] fans might recognize the one pictured above!) as well as the full world of Ambrose:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517448/14e2ba5b9bd93284dac558c8b5a282e22e50ded3.png[/img]

Fans of [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] are sure to notice the similarity, but alas, since the 20 years that [i]Knight Bewitched[/i] took place and the massive flooding that took place in [i]Finding Light[/i], the world is quite different and ready for one last adventure.

Anyway, that's all I have to say for now. If you have any comments, or bug reports/suggestions for any of my games, you're always free to email me at Jkweath@gmail.com or leave a comment here (I'll try to remember to actually  read them this time - this is why I usually stick with email)

notes.title: 4-28-19 update and Knight Bewitched Android version
notes.content:
Hey!

The [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jkgames.knightbewitched]Android version of Knight Bewitched[/url] is currently in beta and will release soon. Its normal price will be $2.99, though on release it will be in sale for just $0.99.

If you're interested in play-testing or have a friend who'd like to play the Android version of Knight Bewitched for free, feel free to email me and I'll be happy to send you a promo key.

Before you begin, however, there are some requirements your mobile device should meet to run the game optimally:

-CPU: 1.7 GHz quad-core
-RAM: 2 GB

Any device with specs similar or greater than a Samsung Galaxy S5 should be in the clear.

If you encounter a bug while playing, please report directly to me at [b]jkweath@gmail.com[/b]. You can report any bug or suggestion you want, but here's some specific things I'm looking for:

[list]
[*] Text cutoff from dialogue boxes and item/skill/etc descriptions
[*] Any error that causes the game to crash
[*] UI suggestions - do the mobile controls feel comfortable?
[*] Performance issues[i][b] if you are using a mid or high-range device.[/b][/i]
[/list]

Currently known mobile edition bugs:

-Sometimes the player will get stuck going on a direction upon entering a new area. To fix this, simply tap the direction the character is stuck in.

-Potent Ethers are currently not restoring as much MP as intended.

[b]Changelog[/b]

A few changes were made to Knight Bewitched for its mobile transition:

[list]
[*] Native resolution is now 1109x624, down from 1280x720.
[*] Base font was changed as the original font was incompatible.
[*] Dialogue was adjusted for the lower resolution. Additionally, some minor dialogue updates were made.
[*] A mobile UI was added. Most other touch screen controls have been disabled.
[*] Lighting effects are now off by default and can be toggled on in the options menu.
[/list]

4-28-19 changelog for the PC and mobile versions:

-A weakness display was added to enemies! When an enemy is hit by an ability or weapon type it is weak against, an icon will display above its healthbar indicating what ability and weapon types it is weak to.

-Some minor dialogue updates were added.

-There are now "paths" between torches in the second section of the Midnight Desert, making it much easier to light the torches to reach the next area.

-Finally got around to fixing some bugged trees/signs/walls/etc that the player could walk through.

-Many skill and enemy balance changes were made. This includes some skills being more powerful--including many monster abilities--and some skills being outright removed, such as Ruth's Repentance (with Holy Strike being buffed and moved up as her final ability) and Gwen's Tincture.

I won't be listing every change here, but the overall result is an increase in difficulty for all difficulty modes, especially later in the game and on higher difficulties. However, having weaknesses displayed will negate some of this difficulty as the player can more easily exploit enemy weaknesses.

As always, and as stated above, email me at [b]Jkweath@gmail.com[/b] if you encounter any problems. If the mobile release of Knight Bewitched performs well, its sequel [i]Finding Light[/i] will come next and any games released in the future will have a dual Android and Steam release.
